header.title: Pay transparency
header.description: Manage how your agency handles salary information and comply with the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

directive.title: EU Pay Transparency Directive
directive.paragraph1: The EU Pay Transparency Directive requires employers to give candidates a salary indication up front and prohibits asking about current pay.
directive.paragraph2: Member states must transpose the directive into national law by 2026. Configure your policy below to stay prepared.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: Choose which rules TalentFlow enforces when posting vacancies and conducting interviews.

enforceSalaryRange.title: Require salary range
enforceSalaryRange.description: Vacancies can only be published once a salary range is filled in.

forbidCurrentSalary.title: Forbid current-salary question
forbidCurrentSalary.description: Hide and block fields that ask for a candidate's current salary.

anonymousBenchmark.title: Allow anonymous benchmark
anonymousBenchmark.description: Share anonymized salary data to enable industry-wide pay benchmarks.

reportingThreshold.label: Reporting threshold (employees)
reportingThreshold.help: Number of employees above which pay-gap reporting becomes mandatory.

defaultCurrency.label: Default currency
defaultCurrency.help: Currency used by default for salary ranges.

defaultFrequency.label: Default salary frequency
defaultFrequency.help: Frequency the job form pre-fills for new vacancies.

report.title: Pay transparency report
report.description: How many of your open vacancies comply with the EU directive (complete salary range).

actionList.title: Action list — vacancies without a complete range
actionList.empty: All open vacancies have a complete salary range. Well done!

saved.title: Policy saved
saved.description: Your pay transparency settings have been updated.

error.title: Save failed
error.description: The policy could not be saved. Please try again.
